def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = instance["customer_ids"]
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]

    # ---------- helpers ----------
    def route_load(route):
        s = 0
        for v in route:
            s += demands[v]
        return s

    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][route[0]] + matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += matrix[route[i]][route[i + 1]]
        return c

    def total_cost(routes):
        return sum(route_cost(r) for r in routes)

    def best_position_insert(route, node):
        # deterministic best feasible insertion (single-route), returns index or None
        load = route_load(route)
        if load + demands[node] > capacity:
            return None, None
        m = len(route)
        if m == 0:
            return 0, matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][depot]
        best_i = None
        best_delta = None

        # compute delta vs removing edge (i-1 -> i) / adding (i-1->node->i)
        # for i in [0..m] inserting before route[i], with route[-1] meaning depot
        # breakpoints:
        # insert at 0: depot->node->route[0], replaces depot->route[0]
        # insert at m: route[m-1]->node->depot, replaces route[m-1]->depot
        if m == 1:
            # faster special-case (also keeps computations stable)
            a = route[0]
            old = matrix[depot][a] + matrix[a][depot]
            new = matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][a] + matrix[a][depot]
            return 0, new - old if new - old < 1e30 else (0, new - old)

        old_cost = matrix[depot][route[0]] + matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(route) - 1):
            old_cost += matrix[route[i]][route[i + 1]]

        for i in range(m + 1):
            if i == 0:
                new_cost = matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][route[0]] + 0
                # add rest of edges among route[0..]
                for k in range(m - 1):
                    new_cost += matrix[route[k]][route[k + 1]]
                new_cost += matrix[route[m - 1]][depot]
            elif i == m:
                new_cost = matrix[depot][route[0]] + 0
